title: Show desktop preview (w/windows) in Activity Switcher
line: Each activity in the Activity Switcher now shows its open windows on top of its wallpaper, like the pager does.
explanation: The Activity Switcher card (ActivityItem.qml) only drew the activity's wallpaper thumbnail, so with slideshow or picture-of-the-day wallpapers activities were hard to recognise, and nothing showed what was open in them. Each card now has a TaskManager.TasksModel filtered to that activity, the current virtual desktop and the switcher's screen, without minimized windows, and draws every window as a scaled outline with its icon in stacking order, between the wallpaper and the title shade.

commits.message:
activitymanager: show the activity's windows on its switcher card

The Activity Switcher only showed each activity's wallpaper, which makes
activities hard to tell apart with slideshow wallpapers. Now each card
also draws the outlines and icons of its windows, the way the pager does.

BUG: 435917

patches.diff:
From 94445e6f8e00066d8e9c78b8f2caeff31e6c8ef4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 17:45:18 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] activitymanager: show the activity's windows on its switcher
 card

The Activity Switcher only showed each activity's wallpaper, which makes
activities hard to tell apart with slideshow wallpapers. Now each card
also draws the outlines and icons of its windows, the way the pager does.

BUG: 435917
---
 .../contents/activitymanager/ActivityItem.qml | 55 +++++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 55 insertions(+)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/activitymanager/ActivityItem.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/activitymanager/ActivityItem.qml
index cbbc63c7c6..34ffc41696 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/activitymanager/ActivityItem.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/activitymanager/ActivityItem.qml
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@ import org.kde.plasma.components as PlasmaComponents
 import org.kde.plasma.extras as PlasmaExtras
 import org.kde.plasma.activityswitcher as ActivitySwitcher
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+import org.kde.taskmanager as TaskManager
 
 import org.kde.kcmutils  // KCMLauncher
 
@@ -79,6 +80,60 @@ Item {
             sourceSize: Qt.size(width, width)
         }
 
+        // Outlines of the activity's windows, like the pager shows them
+        Item {
+            id: windowOutlines
+
+            readonly property rect screenGeometry: Qt.rect(Screen.virtualX, Screen.virtualY, Screen.width, Screen.height)
+
+            anchors.fill: parent
+            visible: screenGeometry.width > 0 && screenGeometry.height > 0
+            clip: true
+
+            TaskManager.VirtualDesktopInfo {
+                id: virtualDesktopInfo
+            }
+
+            Repeater {
+                model: TaskManager.TasksModel {
+                    activity: root.activityId
+                    filterByActivity: true
+                    virtualDesktop: virtualDesktopInfo.currentDesktop
+                    filterByVirtualDesktop: true
+                    screenGeometry: windowOutlines.screenGeometry
+                    filterByScreen: true
+                    filterMinimized: true
+                    groupMode: TaskManager.TasksModel.GroupDisabled
+                }
+
+                delegate: Rectangle {
+                    required property var model
+                    required property var decoration
+
+                    readonly property rect geometry: model.Geometry
+
+                    z: model.StackingOrder
+                    x: Math.round((geometry.x - windowOutlines.screenGeometry.x) * windowOutlines.width / windowOutlines.screenGeometry.width)
+                    y: Math.round((geometry.y - windowOutlines.screenGeometry.y) * windowOutlines.height / windowOutlines.screenGeometry.height)
+                    width: Math.round(geometry.width * windowOutlines.width / windowOutlines.screenGeometry.width)
+                    height: Math.round(geometry.height * windowOutlines.height / windowOutlines.screenGeometry.height)
+
+                    color: Qt.alpha(Kirigami.Theme.backgroundColor, 0.8)
+                    border.width: 1
+                    border.color: Qt.alpha(Kirigami.Theme.textColor, 0.5)
+
+                    Kirigami.Icon {
+                        anchors.centerIn: parent
+                        width: Math.min(Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.medium, parent.width - Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing * 2, parent.height - Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing * 2)
+                        height: width
+                        visible: width > 0
+                        source: parent.decoration
+                        animated: false
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
         // Title and the icon
 
         Rectangle {
--
